description: Keep a note in a recurring block (the app's "Keep for the following days"): from `from_date` on, every occurrence of the repetition shows it — a running log for a project block, a checklist for a routine. Days already planned are included, earlier days are untouched. Nothing is copied: it is one note, the same everywhere. A note written in a recurring block belongs to that day only until it is kept. Get repetition ids from list_recurring_blocks (or `repeats.recurring_block_id` in list_day_blocks); each repetition lists its kept notes in `notes`.

from_date.description: First day the note appears (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (UTC).

name: keep_recurring_block_note
